notices.message: The tracked Aave sGHO contract currently resolves as stkGHO-compatible rather than a full ERC-4626 vault. Pharos uses `previewRedeem` for price discovery and live reserve telemetry, and avoids the generic ERC-4626 reserve adapter until the replacement savings vault exposes standard asset and totalAssets methods.
